_why: AXIS 3 (R-490 section3-1, ordered FIRST). THE OVER-REFUSAL BOUNDARY -- the direction in which
the orphan-zone repair could have gone WIDE. spec-family-bindings.ts:258-260 says the refusal is
scoped INSIDE the session-family branch on purpose, because 'a refusal in the generic dispatch
would also reject e.g. a FILTER whose object merely mentions lunch -- an over-refusal THE
DISCRIMINATOR FIXTURES EXIST TO CATCH.' R-490 section2 measured that claim: ZERO such fixtures
existed. This is that fixture. The caption now describes reality instead of promising it.
A BOUNDED SCOPE IS PROVEN BY WHAT IT EXCLUDES. The three confluence rows carry refused-zone
keywords ('during lunch', 'overnight', 'midday') on NON-session families and MUST BIND NORMALLY.
The sess row carries the SAME 'during lunch' text on WAIT_SESSION and MUST be refused. That
adjacency inside ONE fixture is the discrimination: it separates 'refuses the right thing' from
WHY EVERY PROBE ROW IS role=confluence AND NOT role=spine: spine_total/spine_bound/compiled are
the only plan scalars the oracle adjudicates, and authority section6 does NOT adjudicate
non-session families. Putting the probes in confluence keeps all THREE adjudicated scalars
derivable from the session row + P-5 alone (the section4b/4c row-10 arithmetic), so this fixture
gets real CLAIM 2 coverage on its plan level instead of an unadjudicated shrug.
KEYWORD SPREAD IS DELIBERATE: 'during lunch' and 'midday' are two DIFFERENT lunch_blackout
phrases and 'overnight' is an overnight phrase -- so both refused zones and three distinct
non-session families (FILTER, WAIT_BIAS, WAIT_RETEST) are probed, not one keyword three times.
